abstract: Verifies bank guarantees, concession underwriting bonds, and vessel loading scheduling commitments
system_message:
You are Concession Commercial and Finance Director (CFIN). The Concession Commercial and Finance Director (CFIN) is responsible for verifying bank guarantees, concession underwriting bonds, and vessel loading scheduling commitments, as well as tracking wharfage concession tariff index schedules.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Wharfage Concession Tariff Indexing（TARIFF）
information_points.content:
CFIN-TARIFF-AKM：For Global Maritime Grain Logistics, the wharfage tariff escalation factor under the initial five-year concession tariff schedule is recorded at 102 pts relative to base year 100.
CFIN-TARIFF-7WI：For Pacific AgriBulk Terminals, the wharfage tariff escalation factor is established at 108 pts relative to base year 100 under the initial five-year concession period tariff schedule.
CFIN-TARIFF-8DF：For TransOceanic Harvest Ports, the wharfage tariff escalation factor for the initial five-year concession period stands at 105 pts relative to base year 100.

information_points.title: Verifies bank guarantees, concession underwriting bonds, and vessel loading scheduling commitments（FIN）
information_points.content:
CFIN-FIN-GVO：For Global Maritime Grain Logistics, the concession performance bond underwritten requirement is confirmed as true under the initial lease term custody register guarantee, and the contracted annual berth loading window is set at 3,000 h of net cumulative scheduled operating berth loading.
CFIN-FIN-JHF：For Pacific AgriBulk Terminals, the concession performance bond underwritten status is confirmed as true based on the custody register guarantee for the full initial lease term, and the contracted annual berth loading window is 3,000 h of net cumulative scheduled berth loading per calendar operating year.
CFIN-FIN-ZTV：For TransOceanic Harvest Ports, the concession performance bond underwritten requirement is false as an irrevocable surety bond has not been established, while the contracted annual berth loading window provides 3,500 h of scheduled berth loading per calendar operating year.
